$comment: Seeded by INO-375 when the docs-completeness gate (doc 26 §7 D-gate 3c) was first wired into CI.
Every entry is a PRE-EXISTING §2 gap that predates the gate, kept green so the lint can start
blocking NEW incomplete docs pages today instead of waiting on the 43-component sweep. This is a
ratchet, not a parking lot: each waiver names the issue that deletes it, an unused waiver FAILS
the build, and adding one is a visible diff on a reviewed file.
Do NOT add a waiver to ship a component. Write the missing section. A waiver is for a gap whose
content is a decision someone else owns — and then say so on the issue named below.
INO-371 — A4 full-catalog presentability audit: establishes, per component, which §2 states,
sizes and omissions actually apply, then writes them. Deletes 30 of these entries.
INO-374 — C5 docs pages for the 5 marketing-only components. Deletes the 5 doc entries.
INO-373 (C4 PrimeNG-anatomy page migration) normalises heading NAMES across the 38 docs; the
lint accepts the documented synonym families already, so it needs no waivers for that.
Nothing here waives §2.1 (demo) or §2.4 (labels): all 43 components already resolve to a live
demo and every component with a label @Input documents it. Those two checks are fully armed.
